source.abi_recovery: Contract is not verified on BscScan. Function selectors were independently recovered by (1) extracting all PUSH4 operands from the processor's proxy-implementation bytecode (0x8e1d125def6d3826c278299273a0760d47626068, reached via the proxy's masterCopy() beacon pattern), then (2) keccak256-hashing candidate Solidity function signatures and matching the first 4 bytes. netlist(uint256)->bytes = 0x3fc4be56 and circuitInfo(uint256)->(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256) = 0x084d60f1 both matched; circuitInfo's returned (n_inputs, n_outputs, n_state, n_cells) was then cross-checked against this module's own decode of netlist()'s bytes (nand+latch+ref counts, n_cells) as a second, independent confirmation.
